name: hetzner-cloud
description: Manage Hetzner Cloud and Storage Boxes through an MCP mirror of the official APIs.

interface.longDescription: Use Hetzner Cloud and Storage Boxes from Codex. Mirrors the official APIs with 222 generated tools for servers, volumes, networks, IPs, firewalls, load balancers, DNS, certificates, storage boxes, and other supported resources. Connect through the private local setup page and keep your project API token in your operating system credential store.
defaultPrompt: List my Hetzner servers and their status.
Show the firewall rules for my project.
List my Storage Boxes and their usage.
